preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(a) <= 100000 for a in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each string a in the test cases has length between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in {'A', 'N', 'T', 'O'} for a in test_cases for c in a)
preconditions.description: Each character in string a is one of 'A', 'N', 'T', or 'O'.
The total length of all strings a across test cases does not exceed 100,000.

postconditions.expression: all(len(b) == len(a) for a, b in zip(test_cases, outputs))
postconditions.description: The output string b for each test case has the same length as the input string a.

postconditions.expression: all(sorted(b) == sorted(a) for a, b in zip(test_cases, outputs))
postconditions.description: The output string b is a permutation of the input string a.

postconditions.expression: all(c in {'A', 'N', 'T', 'O'} for b in outputs for c in b)
postconditions.description: Each character in the output string b is one of 'A', 'N', 'T', or 'O'.

postconditions.expression: all(b != a for a, b in zip(test_cases, outputs))
postconditions.description: The output string b is not identical to the input string a (to ensure a non-trivial permutation).

postconditions.expression: all(max_distance(a, b) == max_possible_distance(a) for a, b in zip(test_cases, outputs))
postconditions.description: The output string b maximizes the minimum number of adjacent swaps required to transform b back to a.
